summary: Full e2e testing of Budget Salaires Pro (JWT auth + full redesign). 18/18 backend pytest cases pass and all critical frontend flows verified via Playwright.
critical_code_review_comments: SalairesBudget/Dashboard show 'Chargement…' silently until /api/budget resolves — no error handling on 401/500 responses (minor).
CORS uses FRONTEND_URL env — good; but backend/.env has CORS_ORIGINS='*' which is unused (dead config).
Employees POST /api/employees does not validate department code against departments collection — user can create employee with any string dept.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. All TEST_ prefixed rows created during pytest are deleted in-test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite at /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py covers auth (5), departments (4), employees (3), hypotheses (2), budget (3), journal (1) — all pass. Frontend Playwright verified: login form → dashboard, all 7 sidebar nav items (nav-dashboard/employes/budget/hypotheses/departements/rapports/journal) render their pages, 4 KPI cards populate (Employés=6, Masse=496310$, Budget=846329$, Salaire moyen=82718$), 3 charts render, 17 seeded departments present, add-employee-btn opens dialog and empty submit produces 8 'Ce champ est obligatoire' errors, budget-fiche-dialog opens with no 'Prime chef d'équipe' reference and alloc sécurité 260$, journal shows entries (8+), logout returns to login. Hypotheses page shows CCQ (242j) and standard (261j) grids + 5-row charges table + save-hypotheses-btn. Vacation-includes-primes rule verified via backend test.
